Требования к должностям высшего звена. М: Requirements for top management positions. The model is shorter than the others: at this level a small number of competencies matters, but they are required at a high level.
Требования к должностям логистики, склад: Requirements for logistics, warehouse and procurement positions. Accurate records and meeting deadlines determine the result, so accountability and results orientation weigh more than communication.
Требования к должностям маркетинга. Анал: Requirements for marketing positions. Data analysis is included separately: promotion without measuring return is indistinguishable from spending money.
Собрана при переносе из наименований ком:
Assembled during migration from the competency names found in assessments. Weights are equal because the source schema did not store competency importance.

The model was retired when the corporate competency model was introduced. It is kept to explain the assessments migrated from the source database.
Требования к сотрудникам без опыта самос: Requirements for employees without experience of independent work. Professional competencies are deliberately excluded: at this level what matters is how a person gets involved in work, not what they already know.
Требования к юридическим должностям. Мод: Requirements for legal positions. The model is narrow and deep: the professional competency accounts for almost a third of the weight because no other quality can replace it.
Требования к должностям продаж. Вес орие: Requirements for sales positions. Results orientation is deliberately weighted high: in sales it is measured directly rather than inferred from observation.
Требования к инженерным должностям. Разр: Requirements for engineering positions. Software development is marked as critical: a specialist who has not confirmed it is unfit for the position regardless of other qualities.
Требования к руководителю крупного подра: Requirements for the head of a large unit. Strategic thinking becomes critical: at this level decisions have consequences beyond the unit's planning horizon.
Требования к линейному руководителю. Упр: Requirements for a line manager. People management and decision making are marked as critical: a shortfall in them cannot be compensated because they are the substance of the position.
Требования к самостоятельному исполнител:
Requirements for an independent contributor. Problem solving and analytical thinking are added: a specialist differs from a beginner not in the amount of knowledge but in the ability to act without a ready solution.

The model is used as a fallback: a specialist position with a functional model is assessed against that model. The level model remains active for positions in units whose professional requirements have not yet been described; without it such a position would have no requirements at all and no match score could be calculated.
Requirements for HR positions. Legal support is included at the application level: an HR specialist must be able to tell what is permissible without consulting a lawyer.
Требования к финансовым и учётным должно: Requirements for finance and accounting positions. Accountability weighs as much as professional competencies: an accounting error costs more than slow work.
Требования к должностям административно-: Requirements for facilities, occupational safety and security positions. Accountability weighs more than in any other functional model: the cost of a mistake here is not measured in money.
